# Struc-Arch Pakistan - Full Index

## Company

Struc-Arch Pakistan is a PEC-registered structural, civil and construction-management consultancy based at Kacha, Eminabad Road, Gujranwala 52250, Pakistan. Founded by Saad Afzal (Structural Engineer, PMP, LEED Green Associate, MSc Structural Engineering - UET Taxila, BSc Civil Engineering - UET Lahore).

- Website: https://strucarch.com
- Phone: 0310 3330023
- Email: info@strucarch.com
- PEC firm licence: #Consult/2452
- PEC principal engineer: #Civil/32786

## Services

1. Structural Engineering & Seismic Design (RCC, steel, long-span trusses, ETABS/SAP2000/SAFE)
2. BOQ & Construction Cost Estimation
3. Quantity Surveying
4. Contractor Billing & Interim Payment Certificates (IPC)
5. Building Fitness & Structural Safety Certification (1,588 school structures)
6. Construction Claims, Variation & Extension of Time (EOT) Support
7. Construction Supervision & Project Management
8. Highway & Expressway Engineering (128 km Lilla Jhelum, 74.15 km Gujranwala-Hafizabad, 15.2 km Gujranwala Expressway)
